title.narrative: CAFOD WASH project accampanier to support to WN WASH project

description.narrative: The WASH accompanier role contributes to the delivery of effective and high quality humanitarian assistance to new and ongoing humanitarian crises in White Nile state. The WASH Accompanier does this by providing technical field support as well as supporting the implementation and maintenance of systems and procedures for ensuring good practice and meeting sectoral standards on accountability and programme quality through SIDO (CAFOD key partner in the White Nile Response). Working with partners is central to CAFOD’s humanitarian response and the accompanier will play an important role in improving and developing the capacity of SIDO to prepare for, mitigate the impact of, and respond to crisis by providing support, knowledge and building long-term capacity. All roles undertaken will have the aim of achieving peace, security and recovery in accordance with CAFOD’s mission and values.
